notes.title: Notice of Suspension of Development of Lamia's Bambina
notes.notes:
This is a bit of a disappointing announcement.

We are sorry to announce that we are suspending the development of
Lamia's Bambina
but we have decided to suspend development.

Even if we proceed as is,
We are not able to deliver the game with satisfactory contents,
We are very grateful to all of you who have been looking forward to the game.

To all of you who have been looking forward to the game,
who have subscribed to our wish list,
I am very sorry.

We have been struggling especially for the past three months.
No matter how we tried to improve, we could not reach our ideal,
It pains me to say this, but I have decided to call it quits.

In fact, we have already started work on a new product to be released this summer,
We will complete the development of that first.

We will consider whether we should resume the development of Lamia's Bambina after that,
We will consider whether we should resume development of Ramiaz Bambina after that.

Any further news on the new game?
We will report about the new game in the WAKUWAKU GAMES News,
WAKUWAKU GAMES will keep you informed about the new game in the WAKUWAKU GAMES News.

We will continue to make every effort to release fun games,
We will continue to work hard to bring you fun games.
Thank you very much for your cooperation.

Studio Dragonet
sekiyadn

notes.title: Lamia's News January 2025 Issue
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43676282/be1199bc9e511215b5bce0f76a5e40628e2d9f1f.png[/img]
[h1]Lamias News January 2025 Issue[/h1]

2025 is the "Year of the Snake", so we will be releasing Lamia's News at the end of every month!

Japan has a zodiac sign, and the zodiac sign for 2025 is the snake.

Studio Dragonet will be releasing exciting information, mainly about "Lamias Bambina", which is currently in development, so please look forward to it!

[h2]What is Lamiban? [/h2]
New information in this issue! ...But first, we have prepared a video for those of you who are wondering what Lamiban is.
[previewyoutube=CspnGCLZ0V8;full][/previewyoutube]
In other words, it's a type of RPG where you increase the number of allies and conquer dungeons.

[h3]The Story of Lamiban[/h3]
Ivy, who has been reincarnated in the demon world, aims to revive the Lamia tribe with Princess Hedera.
The player controls Ivy to increase, raise, and fight Lamia,
and recapture Lamia Palace from the Harpies.
The rise and fall of the Lamia tribe depends on this battle. Let's go, Lamiban!

[h2]Summoning System[/h2]
In this issue, we'll introduce you to the [b]Summoning System[/b],
how to increase the number of allies in Lamia's Bambina (hereafter Lamiban)!
Click here for the video.
[previewyoutube=ikDFJe-PvSQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Everyone loves gacha! Gacha!
So, to increase the number of Lamia allies, you need to gacha!
Ah, it's not gacha, it's summoning.

Each summoning formula will summon a unique lamia with a certain probability.
Of course, you can add the summoned lamia to your party and go on an adventure.
Each lamia has different characteristics:
・Easiness of developing each parameter
・Magic you can use
・Passive skills
・Body color

Summon them and find your favorite lamia!
[u][b]Ah, summoning is completed with in-game money, so no additional real money is required! [/b][/u]

So does that mean Lamiban is a game of luck based on the strength of your companions?
If you're not sure,
then.
We'll announce ways to increase your companions other than summoning in the February issue. Check it out!

That's all for this issue. Look forward to the end of next month!
Don't forget to add it to your wishlist!

notes.title: Combat scenes ( in development) are shown.
notes.notes:
Hello.
This is Waku Waku Games.

We are currently working on "Lamia's Bambina" a game about raising lamia and reclaiming territory, which is scheduled to be released in 2023,

Today, I would like to introduce a battle scene.

[previewyoutube=YXEcHchMTs4;full][/previewyoutube]

Lamia's Bambina" features the Lamia, a tribe of demons. The Lamia tribe had been prospering in the demon world, but the war between humans and demons has caused chaos in the demon world, and the Lamia have lost their territory to the Harpies. The player must increase the number of Lamia, raise them to be strong enough to defeat the Harpies, and send them into battle to reclaim their former lands.

The battle scenes in this issue are those of a normal battle of a common soldier class.
The battle system itself is a command selection system familiar to RPGs, with a party of up to four (four?) Lamia. The battle system itself is the familiar command-selection type of RPGs, with a party of up to four (four?) lamia fighting against the enemy. This battle scene is, of course, still under development. When the game reaches your hands, you will be able to enjoy more sophisticated combat.

The background music for "Lamia's Bambina" will be composed by Foilverb ([url=https://twitter.com/Foilverb]https://twitter.com/Foilverb[/url]), who is also in charge of the background music for "Retro Game Aliens. The soundtrack is currently being produced by Foilverb. The soundtracks are being created by Foilverb ([url=[url][95][95][95][95][95]). We plan to release the soundtrack DLC when the game is released. If you are interested in chiptune sounds, please look forward to it.

Studio Dragonet is working on the game with the aim of creating the best and most powerful Lamia, and to make the demon world know that "there is a Lamia in the demon world. We will keep you updated on new elements and other information on this store page.

Cheers,

notes.title: Notice of Exhibit at the Game Pavilion JP
notes.notes:
Hi, everybody! 
This is Waku Waku Games.

We will be exhibiting "Lamia's Bambina" at the Game Pavilion, an indie game exhibition event to be held at the Umeda Sky Building on March 25, 2023, offering the opportunity to try out the latest version of the game currently in development. If you live in the Osaka area, please consider coming to the event. Including "Lamia's Bambina" there will be a lineup of nearly 70 ambitious games. Tickets for the general public can be purchased at the following URL.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43676282/d34045ac174e084177cb7da765855612338af5c5.png[/img]

And, those who play "Lamia's Bambina" will receive a clear file on a first-come, first-served basis. We hope you will use it to store flyers and other materials distributed at the event, and we also hope you will make use of it at home as well! We look forward to seeing you at the Game Pavilion JP this Saturday!
